name: claude-intent-router
description: UserPromptSubmit hook for intent detection and skill routing.

plugins.name: intent-router
plugins.description: UserPromptSubmit hook that detects high-confidence short-phrase intents (status checks, merge confirmations, PR review/finalize requests, planning triggers, pause) and injects skill-routing or rigor-checklist context. Configurable via ~/.claude/intent-router.config.json for project-specific skill names and vocabulary; works with generic fallback text out of the box.
